audience: construction teams who look up known contacts, projects, opportunities and schedules in ConstructionOnline

useCases.title: Find a contact from an email or phone number
useCases.text: Look up an individual contact using a known email address or phone number, or retrieve it directly when you have its ID.

useCases.title: Review a known project
useCases.text: Use a project ID to review its status and address before a project discussion.

useCases.title: Check a schedule’s dates and project
useCases.text: Open a schedule by its known ID to review its dates and associated project.

useCases.title: Look up an individual opportunity
useCases.text: Retrieve selected operational fields for an opportunity using its known ID before discussing it with the team.
